applies_why: The judge does not weigh a live link collision between C4's chain and the defender's chain; it says the attacked curse limb was dropped and no live link remains.
quote: D6 vs C4 (Jeremiah 22:30): UNDERDETERMINED -- C4 pressed against the curse limb the defender dropped in [CR3] LINK 5, so no live link remains to contradict; the dropping is recorded there.
rule_words: When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.
room: The phrase 'pressed against a link': (1) a dropped curse limb is not a live link, so K-C's chain-against-chain requirement is not triggered; (2) K-C applies even after a limb is dropped because C4 was pressed against it. I adopted (1).
why: Because the judge's stated reason is that the challenged curse limb was dropped and no live link remains, not that no individual verse states the contrary, it does not use the verse-by-verse test K-C retires.
